_document_id_conventions.users_and_tanks: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner; document IDs are not duplicated as stored uid or tank_id fields.
_document_id_conventions.batches: CR-YYYYMMDD-###; intentionally duplicated in the batch_id field.
_document_id_conventions.sampling_records: baseline for the initial record; Firestore Auto-ID for later records.
_document_id_conventions.auto_id_collections: mortality_records, harvest_records, feeder_schedules, feeder_commands, and actuator_logs.
_document_id_conventions.feeder_logs: Firestore Auto-ID for app audit entries or durable firmware event ID for ESP32 outcome entries.
_document_id_conventions.fixed_or_time_keyed: currentOwner, latest, status, current; WQAD history uses YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS.

users._id: Firestore document ID: Firebase Authentication UID (not a stored field)
users._description: User profile. Tank ownership is not duplicated here; the canonical relationship is tanks/{tankId}.owner_uid. Subcollections: notification_settings/preferences and notif_markers. FCM device tokens live in users/{uid}.fcmTokens.
fields: photoUrl (legacy alias, removed on canonical writes)
fcmTokens (array<string>, one token per logged-in device)

users/{uid}/notification_settings/prefer._description: Per-user notification preferences. Created automatically on signup.

users/{uid}/notif_markers/{key}._description: Server-side idempotency markers for reminders and other scheduled notification checks.

hardware_system/currentOwner._description: Current assignment for the one physical hardware package. A valid assignment is either uid/tank_id both null, or an active owner whose canonical tanks/{tankId}.owner_uid value matches uid.
fields: assigned_by (admin uid, retained from last assignment)

tanks._id: Firestore document ID: owner Firebase Authentication UID (not a stored field)
tanks._description: Owner tank root. Sensor, actuator, feeder, Water Quality Anomaly Detection, and production data are nested below it.

sensor_readings/latest._description: Latest complete routed sensor snapshot. Written by Cloud Functions from ESP staging; read by the owner.

sensor_readings_history/{YYYY-MM-DD}._description: Server-maintained daily summary parent for long-range Analytics. Completed sanitized summaries are rebuilt from their raw 10-minute entries when needed.

sensor_readings_history/{YYYY-MM-DD}/ent._description: Canonical 10-minute per-sensor window aggregates, partitioned by original Manila capture date. Invalid sensors are omitted rather than stored as sentinel values.
fields: temp_min, temp_max, temp_avg (when valid samples exist)
turbidity_min, turbidity_max, turbidity_avg (when valid samples exist)
pH_min, pH_max, pH_avg (when valid samples exist)
DO_min, DO_max, DO_avg (when valid samples exist)
waterLevel_min, waterLevel_max, waterLevel_avg (when valid samples exist)

sensors/{sensorName}._description: Per-sensor threshold configuration. Owner writes validated min/max values; the assigned ESP reads them.

actuators/{deviceId}._description: App requests control_mode; ESP reports the actual relay current_state and last_changed.
fields: last_changed (Timestamp|null; legacy int epoch-ms may exist)

actuator_logs/{logId}._description: Actuator activity log. Owner-request logs and ESP-confirmed physical/AUTO changes use the same canonical collection.
fields: logged_at (Firestore Timestamp; legacy timestamp/epoch values remain readable by the app)

feeder/status._description: Current feeder status written by the ESP32. command_id ties manual outcomes to the originating Feed Now request.
fields: lastSeen (Timestamp; legacy int epoch-ms remains readable)

feeder_schedules/{scheduleId}._description: Recurring scheduled feeding configuration. effective_at_ms prevents a newly created/edited/enabled schedule from being treated as retroactively due.
fields: isDone (bool, legacy compatibility; true only for completed current occurrence)
last_occurrence_at (Timestamp, optional; legacy int epoch-ms remains readable)

feeder_logs/{logId}._description: Feeding lifecycle/audit logs. Physical completion is confirmed by the ESP; the app can also write schedule, pending-confirmation, and error audit entries.
fields: logged_at (Firestore Timestamp; legacy timestamp/epoch values remain readable)

feeder_commands/{commandId}._description: Manual Feed Now commands pending ESP execution. Flutter creates; ESP reads and deletes processed commands. Commands expire so an offline write cannot become a fresh motor command after reconnect.

water_quality_anomaly_detections/{detect._description: Machine Learning-Based Water Quality Anomaly Detection (WQAD) documents. `current` is the live alias; timestamp-named documents provide history. The unsupervised model learns the tank's usual multivariate sensor patterns without threshold-derived labels. Written by the Python Cloud Function via Admin SDK.
fields: anomaly_score (0-100 percentile relative to learned reference patterns; not a safety score)
source (WQAD model|Model unavailable|Insufficient data|Stale sensor history)
primary_driver (object|null: sensor, label, value, unit, direction, contribution_score)
contributors (array of sensor, label, value, unit, direction, contribution_score)

water_quality_anomaly_detection_history/._description: Hourly WQAD history records using the same payload as water_quality_anomaly_detections/current. New writes go here; legacy timestamp-named documents in the current-alias collection remain readable during transition.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}._description: Nested crayfish batch document using canonical snake_case fields.
fields: ended_at (Timestamp|null, set when superseded without harvest)

_derived_not_stored.initial_abw: initial_total_weight / sample_count; computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.initial_abl: initial_total_length / sample_count; computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.final_abw: Computed from total_weight / sample_size in the latest sampling record for the batch
_derived_not_stored.final_abl: Computed from total_length / sample_size in the latest sampling record for the batch
_derived_not_stored.days_in_culture: Calendar-day difference from stocking_date to today for active batches, or to harvest_date / ended_at for completed or superseded batches; computed in the app and not stored
_derived_not_stored.legacy_read_behavior: Older batch documents may contain average fields; raw totals and sampling records take precedence when available.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/samplin._description: Sampling records nested under their batch.

_derived_not_stored.avg_body_weight: total_weight / sample_size; computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.avg_body_length: total_length / sample_size; computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.biomass: live_count * (total_weight / sample_size); computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.legacy_read_behavior: Older records may still contain average and biomass fields; app derives values from raw source fields and deletes legacy computed fields when a record is edited.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/mortali._description: Mortality records nested under their batch.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/harvest._description: Harvest records nested under their batch.

_derived_not_stored.abw_grams: total_weight_kg * 1000 / harvest_count; computed in the app
_derived_not_stored.legacy_read_behavior: Legacy abw_grams is ignored; editing an old harvest record deletes it.

notifications/{notifId}._description: Root notification collection scoped by uid. Deterministic IDs are used where one physical event must map to one notification record across multiple devices.

sensorIngestion/current._description: Dedicated ESP Email/Password service-account staging document for the 5-second live snapshot. Cloud Functions validate the source assignment and route it to the currently assigned tank.
fields: captured_at_ms (int epoch-ms when NTP is synced)
temperature (double; -1 sentinel possible when live probe invalid)

sensorIngestion/current/history/{docId}._description: Dedicated ESP Email/Password service-account append-only 10-minute aggregate staging entry. Cloud Functions preserve captured_at_ms as recorded_at, validate the original assignment binding, and quarantine mismatches rather than attributing them to a new owner.
fields: captured_at_ms (int epoch-ms when NTP is synced)
